meta.name: Publish Instagram carousels from Google Sheets using Gemini and GCS

name: Instagram Carousel — Community

parameters.content:
## Instagram Carousel — Community

### How it works

1. Triggers daily to read carousel data.
2. Processes and evaluates carousel eligibility.
3. Generates carousel content using AI.
4. Creates slides and uploads them to storage.
5. Publishes the carousel on Instagram and logs the event.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure Google Sheets API credentials for accessing carousel data.
- [ ] Set up API credentials for the Language Model used for content generation.
- [ ] Ensure Google Cloud Storage and Facebook Graph API are properly authenticated.

### Customization

Adjust the schedule trigger for different posting frequencies.

## Trigger and read data

Schedule trigger reads carousel data from Google Sheets.

## Evaluate carousel eligibility

Selects and evaluates the first eligible carousel row, marking it for processing if valid.

## Generate carousel concept

Prepares inputs and uses a language model to generate carousel concepts.

## Generate caption and slides

Generates and parses carousel captions and slides using an LLM chain.

## Build and validate slides

Builds slide prompts and validates images.

## Image processing

Converts and resizes images, prepares for upload.

## Upload and container creation

Uploads slides to GCS and creates Facebook child containers.

## Validate and poll child containers

Validates and manages child container polling and errors.

## Handle child errors

Handles errors in polling child containers, includes timeout.

## Create parent container

Creates Instagram parent container and builds a schedule for polling.

## Parent container polling

Manages the polling of parent containers and checks for errors.

## Handle parent errors

Handles terminal errors in parent container operations.

## Publish and notify

Publishes carousel on Instagram, commits status, and notifies via email.

parameters.jsCode: const eligible = $input.all().find(item => { const j = item.json || {}; const status = String(j.status || '').toLowerCase(); return Boolean(j.RowKey) && status !== 'published' && status !== 'processing'; }); return eligible ? [eligible] : [];

parameters.text: =Create one coherent Instagram carousel concept. Topic: {{ $json.Topic }}. Audience: {{ $json.TargetAudience }}. Voice: {{ $json.BrandVoice }}. Goal: {{ $json.Goal }}. Key message: {{ $json.KeyMessage }}. The concept must support a 5–6 slide narrative. Return structured output only.

=Write one polished Instagram caption for this carousel concept: {{ $("Generate Carousel Concept").item.json.output.concept }}. Topic: {{ $("Prepare Carousel Inputs").item.json.Topic }}. Audience: {{ $("Prepare Carousel Inputs").item.json.TargetAudience }}. Voice: {{ $("Prepare Carousel Inputs").item.json.BrandVoice }}. Goal: {{ $("Prepare Carousel Inputs").item.json.Goal }}. Key message: {{ $("Prepare Carousel Inputs").item.json.KeyMessage }}. CTA: {{ $("Prepare Carousel Inputs").item.json.CTA }}. Do not invent factual claims. Return structured output only.

=Create exactly 5 or 6 Instagram carousel slides for: {{ $("Generate Carousel Concept").item.json.output.concept }}. Each slide needs index, role, short mobile-readable image_text, and a concrete visual idea. Build a coherent sequence: hook → development → useful takeaway → CTA/closure. Return structured output only.

parameters.jsCode: const source = $input.first().json; const slides = source.output?.slides || source.slides || []; if (slides.length < 5 || slides.length > 6) throw new Error(`Expected 5–6 slides, got ${slides.length}`); return slides.map((s,i) => ({ json: { slide_index: s.index || i+1, role: s.role || '', slide_text: s.image_text || '', idea: s.idea || '', prompt: `Finished square 1:1 Instagram carousel slide. Create a realistic editorial photograph with a clean text-safe area and render this exact short overlay text clearly: "${s.image_text || ''}". Visual idea: ${s.idea || ''}. Role: ${s.role || ''}. Premium but brand-neutral, natural lighting, mobile-readable composition. No logos, no watermarks, no sci-fi UI, no CGI.` } }));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: "gemini-3.1-flash-image", input: [{ type: "text", text: $json.prompt }], response_format: { type: "image", mime_type: "image/jpeg", aspect_ratio: "1:1", image_size: "1K" } } }}

parameters.jsCode: let image = $json.output_image; if (typeof image === 'string') image = { data: image, mime_type: 'image/jpeg' }; if (!image?.data) { const blocks = ($json.steps || []).flatMap(s => Array.isArray(s.content) ? s.content : []); image = blocks.find(b => b?.type === 'image' && b.data); } if (!image?.data) throw new Error('Gemini returned no slide image'); return { json: { imageBase64: image.data, mimeType: image.mime_type || 'image/jpeg', slide_index: $itemIndex + 1 } };

const items = $input.all(); const ids = items.map(i => i.json.id).filter(Boolean); const expected = $('Build Carousel Slide Prompts').all().length; if (expected < 5 || expected > 6) throw new Error(`Invalid expected slide count: ${expected}`); if (ids.length !== expected) throw new Error(`Expected ${expected} child container IDs, received ${ids.length}`); return [{ json: { child_ids: ids, children: ids.join(','), expected_count: expected } }];

parameters.errorMessage: One or more Instagram carousel child containers never reached FINISHED.

parameters.jsCode: const statuses=$input.all().map(i=>i.json); const expected=$('Validate and Aggregate Child IDs').item.json.expected_count; if(statuses.length!==expected) throw new Error(`Expected ${expected} child statuses, received ${statuses.length}`); const terminal=statuses.find(s=>['ERROR','EXPIRED'].includes(s.status_code)); const allFinished=statuses.every(s=>s.status_code==='FINISHED'); return [{json:{all_finished:allFinished,terminal_error:!!terminal,terminal_status:terminal?.status_code||'',children:$('Validate and Aggregate Child IDs').item.json.children,expected_count:expected}}];
const id=$input.first().json.id; if(!id) throw new Error('Parent container ID missing'); return [5,10,20,40].map((delay,i)=>({json:{container_id:id,delay,attempt:i+1}}));
